Poker / Study utilities

What was checked, and what was not.

A working link, a read page and a tested product are three different claims. This page shows what the resource catalogue actually records and how to report a correction.

What is in this snapshot?

146 unique resource destinations: 144 public-page reviews and 2 search-index-only records. These describe review methods, not product quality scores.

146 unique destinations on 75 hostnames. 127 free, 7 mixed, 12 paid. Hostnames are not a count of independent owners. Collection links reuse these listings and do not inflate the total.

The guide library contains 47 entries. Topic collections reuse directory records; their links do not create additional unique sources. The finder also includes hubs and glossary definitions, which are not counted as extra guides.

What do the review labels mean?

Public page read means the public content or catalogue page was inspected within the limitations on that listing. It does not mean a paid book was read, an entire podcast heard, software accuracy tested, or every linked page verified.

Search index only means the direct destination was not adequately accessible for a page review. The listing carries that limitation explicitly. Prefer a directly inspectable official source for an important current decision.

Free, Paid and Mixed describe the resource being listed. Free documentation can explain a paid product; a free review is not free access to the book. Read the description and caution together.

A review date is not a lifetime guarantee.

Individual catalogue review dates, not a site-wide recheck

Changing the website does not reset these dates. A successful HTTP check establishes reachability at that time, not factual freshness, safety, availability in your location or commercial quality. No automatic link checker is allowed to turn a retrieval result into a new editorial review date.

Schedules, policies and software terms should be checked at the original source before use. This page reports recorded dates, not a live promise that all destinations work. It contains no independently audited quality ranking.

Records with direct-review limitations

  • New Jersey: Internet gaming information and dispute routes: Search-index text inspected; direct retrieval returned 403. The older nj.gov address returned 404. No linked provider list, individual approval or personal eligibility was verified. Recheck the official page.
  • TDA rule downloads and translation access: Search-index description checked; direct page retrieval timed out. Downloads and translations were not individually reviewed. Check the document version and the event rules actually adopted.

Send a correction that can be checked.

Use the existing contact page and include the page or resource title, its link, the specific problem and the original source supporting a correction. Do not send passwords, payment details, private hand histories or identifying allegations about another player.

Suggestions are reviewed before publication. A suggested destination is not automatically added, and a source is not endorsed because it appears in search. No paid placement or affiliate tracking was introduced by this release.

Take the context with the link.

Download the complete Markdown directory or the structured JSON catalogue. Both retain dates and limitations. The finder's study list saves selected public entries to a file only when you choose to download it. Neither file updates itself.

Prepared with AI assistance. Published October 8, 2026. Catalogue counts and tables are generated from the same records used by the directory. This is transparency about editorial scope, not a security or accessibility certification.
